column1: # The coverage/cost frontier for selective PSTATE.DIT placement.
# Per resumption = (N=1 run minus N=0 run). Seed: the server's ticket key.
# Each row buys coverage and pays over-protection. NO configuration reaches 0
# and the most conservative one costs 93% of blanket's over-protection - so on
# THIS workload (which is ~2/3 crypto) there is no sound-and-cheaper setting.
# That is the framework's Q1 answering "use blanket here"
# callers the analysis never considered tainted (free 530
